_comment: Pinned toolchain for this repo's evidence, CHECKED (not merely recorded)
before any PVT point is simulated. Ported from gf180-comparator/sim/
toolchain.json -- re-derived against this host's install, not copied
blind.
pdk_release       the IHP-Open-PDK release this repo's evidence was
generated against, read from the installed
checkout's own '.fetched-version' marker (matches
sim/pdk.json's release_tag with the leading 'v'
dropped, e.g. 'v0.3.0' -> '0.3.0'). EXACT, because
the release IS the device models: a different one
silently yields numbers no other record in sim/ is
comparable with. Set to null to disable the check
(not recommended).
ngspice_min_major floor, not an exact match -- newer ngspice is
allowed and recorded; older is refused. SG13G2's
OSDI (pre_osdi) control command needs ngspice built
with OSDI support; ngspice-46 is the version this
repo has confirmed that on (sim/pdk.json).
python_min        floor, as 'major.minor'. Harness is stdlib-only.
openvaf_tag       upstream OpenVAF-Reloaded release tag
sim/tools/build-osdi.sh pins (checksum, not just
this tag) to compile the PDK's own PSP103/r3_cmc
Verilog-A sources into the .osdi files the corner
runner pre_osdi-loads. RECORDED, NOT CHECKED here:
that pin (and its sha256s) lives in
sim/tools/build-osdi.sh itself and is verified at
OSDI-build time, which runs OUTSIDE the corner
runner -- the runner only consumes the resulting
.osdi files under PDK_ROOT/<pdk>/libs.tech/ngspice/osdi/.
A drift is fatal by default; --allow-toolchain-drift overrides it and stamps
the drift into every record written under it.
